"""P013 dev criterion: HTJ2K transfer syntax UIDs are defined on import."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "src"))


def test_htj2k_uid_defined():
    from pydicom.uid import HTJ2K, HTJ2KLossless, HTJ2KLosslessRPCL, UID

    for uid in (HTJ2KLossless, HTJ2KLosslessRPCL, HTJ2K):
        assert isinstance(uid, UID)
        assert len(str(uid)) > 0

"""P013 dev criterion: comparing an unmapped SRT code returns False, no KeyError."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "src"))


def test_srt_unknown_mapping_eq_false():
    from pydicom.sr.coding import Code

    wrong_srt_code = Code("111729", "SRT", "Specimen storage")
    sct_code = Code("127790008", "SCT", "Staining")
    assert (wrong_srt_code == sct_code) is False

"""P013 dev criterion: DataElement repr reflects contents, like str does."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "src"))


def test_repr_reflects_contents():
    from pydicom import Dataset
    from pydicom.dataelem import DataElement

    ds = Dataset()
    elem = DataElement(0x300A00B0, "SQ", [Dataset()])
    ds.add(elem)
    assert repr(elem) == str(elem)
    assert "300A" in repr(elem)
